🦠 What is HMPV?
Human metapneumovirus (HMPV) is a respiratory virus causing cold-like symptoms or severe illnesses like pneumonia. High-risk groups: kids, elderly, and immunocompromised. Spread via droplets & contact. No vaccine, prevention is key!
